errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с етикета "Рециклиране на био отпадъци (кг/човек)".
errors.evidence: The Y-axis does not have a text label. This information is derived from the figure's caption, not from the axis itself.

errors.text_span: Диапазонът на стойностите е от приблизително 10 до 80.
errors.evidence: The Y-axis range shown in the plot is from 0 to 100, not 10 to 80. The description confuses the data range with the axis range.

errors.text_span: Стойностите са подредени на интервали от 10.
errors.evidence: The tick marks on the Y-axis are at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100), not 10.

errors.text_span: Линията започва на приблизителна стойност от 10
errors.evidence: The blue line for Bulgaria clearly starts at a value of 0 on the y-axis, not 10.
The blue line for Bulgaria ends at a value of approximately 34 at year 20, not 20.

errors.text_span: Линията започва на приблизителна стойност от 60
errors.evidence: The red line for EU-27 starts at approximately 65, so 60 is a slight undervaluation.

errors.text_span: достига пик около 80 около 19-та година и остава на приблизително 80 до 20-та година.
errors.evidence: The red line for EU-27 shows a continuous upward trend. It does not peak at year 19 and then stay flat. The value at year 19 is approximately 87, and it rises to approximately 90 by year 20. The value is also incorrectly stated as 80.
